title: I made a quick browser-based tennis sim game
author: kilohe
selftext:
I have always been a big fan of "spreadsheet", web-based sim games and used to daydream about making silly little games. Now that vibecoding has allowed me to turn them from Excel files into half-decent apps I decided to give it a better go and created this tennis game: [legendsim.com](http://legendsim.com)

It is a tennis career game where you start at 16 and play through to retirement in about 15 minutes. Each season gives you a few decisions to make which will improve your player or harm their career if you get it wrong. The goal is to push your overall as high as you can and collect titles to finish with the highest possible score (which is 100, but should hopefully be tricky to get).

It’s free, no account required, runs in your browser, and takes about 15 minutes. 

Now that I'm happy with the tennis engine, the plan is to add more sports later on. Let me know if you try it and have suggestions!
